name: Skydio
summary: U.S. drone maker centered on autonomy for enterprise and defense users.
overview: Skydio develops autonomous drones for public safety, enterprise, and defense.
bull_case: Secure, autonomous U.S.-made drones have strategic demand across public-sector markets.
bear_case: Hardware supply chains and competition from lower-cost systems can challenge economics.

intelligence.description: Skydio builds autonomous drones and software for defense, public safety, infrastructure and other enterprise uses.
company: Skydio designs and manufactures autonomous drones in the United States, prioritizing enterprise and government customers over consumer hardware.
Its autonomy stack and domestic supply chain are central to its pitch as organizations reduce reliance on Chinese drone suppliers.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Skydio is one of the most important private benchmarks in U.S. defense and industrial autonomy. Its latest funding shows that investors will support hardware companies when revenue quality and strategic demand are credible.

changed.text: Raised $230M in Series E funding to expand U.S. drone manufacturing.
Raised $110M in Series F funding at a $4.4B valuation.

takeaways: Skydio benefits from national-security demand for domestic drone supply.
Autonomy software and production scale must advance together.
Government procurement concentration is a core operating risk.
